grids.authorization.port: 6 actions x 6 roles (5 + none) x 3 kinds (person, agent, none) x own/other x 10 token-scope sets; authorization.edge: 6 actions x 2 roles x 6 user-id pairs

grids.limiter: 11 hand-written sequences and 6 seeded random walks of 170 steps, the table dumped after each step
